releaseNotes: Simplified Overview to focus exclusively on your currently connected Wi-Fi network (SSID, connection status, signal strength, download & upload speed, connected quality score and label, and last measurement time).
Focused Networks tab on your latest completed scan session with persistent session restoration across restarts, Scan Now empty state, and automatic background cloud synchronization.
Updated Analytics across Android and website to display understandable measurements relevant to your latest completed scan session and connected Wi-Fi only.
